prompts.prompt: Wide photo of a standup comedy stage in Stockholm, the performer standing center holding a microphone under warm stage lights, laughing audience filling tiered seating in the foreground, red velvet curtains framing the proscenium, atmospheric haze drifting through the beams.

Medium shot on stage at Scalateatern during a standup set, a comedian in a dark blazer gripping a handheld microphone, mouth open mid-punchline, a single wooden stool and water glass beside them, soft amber spotlights against black backdrop.

Environmental photo inside Bio Skandia's ornate cinema interior, vintage balcony seating draped in shadow, gilded walls catching dim foyer light, a lone comedian walking across the wooden stage checking the mic, empty red seats receding into the background.

Close detail shot of a standup performer's hand wrapped around a silver microphone on Scalateatern's stage, sweat visible on their forehead, blurred warm bokeh of stage bulbs behind, the fabric of a black sleeve crisp in the foreground.

Intimate candid of a standup comedian seated on a stool during a quiet moment at Bio Skandia, head tilted back in genuine laughter, two audience members leaning forward smiling in soft front-row light, shadows pooling in the historic theater's upper balconies.
